_README: Program-SPECIFIC config only. Each entry in `programs` becomes ONE static form page at docs/<collegeSlug>/<programSlug>/. Everything whose wording is the same across programs (intro copy, question labels/hints/types, notes, suggested-answer pools) lives in phrasings.json, which is shared by every form. After editing either file, run `node build.js` and commit the JSON + the regenerated docs/.

_FIELDS.collegeSlug / programSlug: URL-safe folder names (lowercase, hyphens). Page URL = <site>/<collegeSlug>/<programSlug>/. Non-conforming values are auto-slugified with a warning.
_FIELDS.college: Full college/partner name shown to the employer. Fills {college} in the shared intro.
_FIELDS.programTitle: The skills-training course title. Baked into the PDF; fills {programTitle} in the shared intro. Employers do NOT answer this.
_FIELDS.credential: Credential / certification name. Baked into the PDF.
_FIELDS.roles: Candidate roles this program could fill — the only program-specific question content. Shown as the Q2 role+counter grid. Keep it short and realistic; employers can add their own roles too. Leave [] to let employers type all their own.
_FIELDS.intro.goalHtml: OPTIONAL per-program override of the shared intro goal text (phrasings.json intro.goalHtml). Usually omit and let the shared template fill {programTitle}/{college}.
_FIELDS.where-wording-lives: Question labels/hints/order, intro copy, the 'no hiring commitment' note, the footer, and all suggested/auto-generated answers are in phrasings.json (shared, program-neutral).
